bounded_question: Can the accepted Production/Home hierarchy and COMP-01 control grammar form one credible Kymaean application shell without inventing unresolved Product semantics or becoming a generic card/dashboard UI?
frozen_inputs: Production -> current situation -> meaningful element -> contextual inspection/editing
shell_scope: durable app identity and Production scope selector
quiet Search / Settings / More platform verbs
current Scene / what matters / recent movement reorientation
construction_law: Use text for unresolved domain navigation; do not invent bespoke Scene/Take/Perspective/Character glyphs.
Use conventional Fluent/platform symbols only for familiar software verbs already covered by FICON F1.
Current Production and resume target must dominate durable navigation and library management.
Supporting current meaning uses one continuous authored field with separators/channels rather than repeated cards.
Other Productions use quiet collection rows rather than cover-art tiles or dashboard cards.
Primary resume action stays monochrome; teal is reserved for real selection reinforcement.
Healthy persistence stays quiet; exceptions remain application-side and explicit.
Bellweather remains a separate app-brand integration input and is not placed by this gate.
mechanical_acceptance: zero undersized icon-only controls below 32px reference carrier
visible solid 2px keyboard focus with 2px offset
selection witness remains structurally independent from focus
no external resources or image dependency
Light/Dark preserve identical navigation and command meaning
visual_falsification: current situation must visually dominate shell chrome
durable navigation must recede rather than become a product taxonomy
the Home must not read as a generic SaaS dashboard/card grid
the dark Scene/Stage witness must remain invariant across themes
Production switching must read as transient scope change, not a permanent library takeover
narrow layout must preserve one primary reading sequence without horizontal escape
result_law: Responsive repairs may alter geometry only. Any change to frozen F2/D3/MAT/TYP/STA/FICON/Stage mechanisms requires a separately named successor rather than silent COMP-02 retuning.
